evidence: Every value the judge creates uses a unique JUDGE-* token (62 distinct tokens across functional, polish K1-K3 and constraints gate G1; e.g. 'Gate check JUDGE-G1', 'Persist parent JUDGE-S0', 'Costs estimate sent to Gwen JUDGE-TE'). A case-insensitive grep for 'judge-' over environment/ (seed_data.json, sha b256f85e... identical in both seed copies and matching raw-evidence-index), solution/ (server.js e4d9402d..., app.js fd8df974..., index.html 4def918a...), instruction.md, instructions/*.md and app_context.md returns no hit, so no probe text is in the seed or reference markup. Literal-search probes '100%', 'A_1', 'X*9' and '1000 pounds' also do not occur in the seed (only '100%' as CSS widths). State mutations are also not pre-satisfied by the seed: M-13 timer seeded 30 -> judge sets 7; M-12 seeded timer_days null -> persistence sets 30; M-12 walled only [dev] and M-11 walled [] -> judge walls Sian; 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' (K-17) seeded hold:true -> release mutates it; JUDGE-H1 hold is on a new message; and no earlier criterion pre-sets any of these (shared-DB order checked). No token is a substring of another token in a way that a search/mentions check could be pre-satisfied (e.g. 'Hold child JUDGE-H1' vs 'Hold grandchild JUDGE-H1C', JUDGE-M1 vs JUDGE-ME1, JUDGE-W0 vs JUDGE-WL0 are distinct). Retry suffix '-2' rule (functional prompt.md, Evidence discipline) avoids collisions with an earlier attempt's writes. Broken-app probe: a static/seed-copy facade cannot display any JUDGE-* text, so it cannot pass a mutation check; conforming-alternative probe: since probes are absent from the fixed seed, any correct app starts without them and is not penalised. Seed-sourced search terms ('original lease scan', 'notice recieved', 'heads of terms', 'rent review date') are intentional negatives about seeded data, not created probes. This is a static source check; check-probe-not-in-seed.py was applied manually, not executed as a private checker.
